profile.summaryJa: 士師記3:1は、イスラエルを試すため残された諸民族を説明する文脈でカナン人を挙げる。ここでのカナンは古代の地域・住民を指す語で、現在の国家境界と同一視できない。
profile.modernLocationJa: 古代のレバント南部を指す歴史的地域名。時代や文脈により範囲が変わり、現代国境にそのまま対応しない。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 士師記では地域名と「カナンの王」という政治的呼称の双方で現れる。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地図にある位置は従来資料の参考候補であり、所在地の比定は未確定です。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
The LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who lived in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.
The hand of the children of Israel prevailed more and more against Jabin the king of Canaan, until they had destroyed Jabin king of Canaan.
“The kings came and fought, then the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach by the waters of Megiddo. They took no plunder of silver.
They found among the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead four hundred young virgins who had not known man by lying with him; and they brought them to the camp to Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.
